channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: Condenan a hombre en Estados Unidos por crear canciones con IA: cobraba millones en regalías a plataformas de streaming con reproducciones falsas
item.description: El Tiempo: A man was convicted in the US of using AI-made songs and fake plays to collect millions in streaming royalties.

item.title: «Хотя бы GTA 6 на это куплю»: хакер нашёл уязвимость PS5 с помощью ИИ и получил от Sony $50 тысяч
item.description: VGTimes: A hacker reportedly used AI to find a PS5 vulnerability and received a $50,000 reward from Sony, with no abuse reported.

item.title: 韩国破获一个利用人工智能窃取800万条个人数据记录的犯罪团伙。
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Korean police broke up a group that used generative AI to hack systems and steal more than 8 million personal data records.

item.title: Spoofing the Toolbox: Optimizing Tool Descriptions to Deceive LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows attackers can optimise tool descriptions to deceive LLM agents into choosing malicious tools.

item.title: Deletion, Substitution, Repair and Transplant: Component Attribution in BARBICAN, a Layered Prompt-Injection Gateway for MCP
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper analyses component contributions in BARBICAN, a layered prompt-injection gateway for MCP tool mediation.

item.title: A Deterministic Security Runtime for LLM Agents on MPI and Batch-Scheduled HPC Systems: Consensus-Governed, Hardware-Rooted Supervision of Every Rank
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes a deterministic security runtime to supervise LLM agents launching jobs on HPC systems.

item.title: Agent-to-Agent Synthetic Social Engineering on the Web
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper defines synthetic social engineering between AI agents requesting actions their users never authorised.

item.title: Combinatorial Lock for Trojan-Resilient AI Engines via Hash-Assisted Spectral Filtering
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes a hash-assisted spectral filtering defense against multi-trigger backdoor attacks on models.

item.title: From Instructions to Exploits: Applying Program Analysis to Malicious Agent Skills Across Natural Language and Code
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper applies program analysis to detect malicious third-party agent skills spanning natural language and code.

item.title: NameTrap: Steering AI Coding Agents Toward Security Vulnerabilities via Variable Names
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows variable names in web-hosted code can steer AI coding agents toward writing vulnerable code.

item.title: CyberDual: AI Attackers versus AI Code Reviewers in Real Software Maintenance
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper introduces CyberDual, an arena pitting AI attackers hiding bugs against AI code reviewers.

item.title: SentryBench: A Cost-Sensitive Benchmark for Adversarial Robustness of Tool-Using LLM Agents in Public-Safety Deployments
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper introduces SentryBench for adversarial robustness of tool-using LLM agents in public-safety deployments.

item.title: LLM WikiLeaks: Uncovering URL-Based Capability Extension and Security Circumvention in Agentic Message Boards
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper examines how agents on message boards use URLs to extend capabilities and circumvent security controls.

item.title: From Representations to Computational Trajectories: Intrinsic Fingerprinting for Large Language Model Provenance Verification
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes intrinsic fingerprinting to verify LLM provenance after unauthorised weight modification.

item.title: Attack logics, not outputs: Concept-based Property Attacks for Shortcut Elimination in Neural Networks
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes concept-based property attacks to expose shortcuts and robustness flaws in vision neural networks.

item.title: The Target Agent Is Its Own Best Critic but a Poor Proposer: Self-Improved Red Teaming
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies self-improved red teaming where a target agent critiques and proposes adversarial attacks.

item.title: Steering for Safety, Hijacking for Profit: Trojan Threats in the LLM Activation Steering Supply Chain
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows trojaned LLM activation steering vectors can hijack models via the plugin supply chain.

item.title: GuardRAG: A Post-Retrieval Defense against Poisoning Attacks in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents GuardRAG, a post-retrieval defense against corpus poisoning attacks in RAG systems.

item.title: Then there is prompt injection, a malicious email, ...: The Wild Wide West of OpenClaw Agentic System Security
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper examines security risks in the OpenClaw AI assistant framework, including prompt injection via malicious email.

item.title: The Agent in the Middle: How AI-Mediated Access Reshapes Web Vulnerability Exploitation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies how AI agents that call backend service interfaces change the way web vulnerabilities are exploited.

item.title: Extraction meets Distillation - cryptanalytic techniques to recover parameters from a Deep Neural Network
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper combines cryptanalytic extraction with distillation to recover parameters of a deep neural network.

item.title: Scope-Gap Injection: Exploiting Evaluator Channel Blind Spots in the OpenClaw Agent Security Competition
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper describes Scope-Gap Injection against multi-stage LLM-agent safety pipelines in an IJCAI OpenClaw competition.

item.title: A Certified Robustness Framework for Backdoor Poisoning Attacks using $f$-Divergences
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper offers a certified robustness framework against data and backdoor poisoning using f-divergences.

item.title: CoSA: The Conflict of Skills Attack in Real-World LLM Agent Ecosystems
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper introduces the Conflict of Skills attack, where composed LLM agent Skills violate policy even if each is checked alone.

item.title: One Leak Away: How Pretrained Model Exposure Amplifies Jailbreak Risks in Finetuned LLMs
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows how exposure of a pretrained model amplifies jailbreak risk in finetuned LLMs.

item.title: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Governance Across the Memory Lifecycle
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv survey covers attacks, defenses and governance for long-term memory in LLM agents.

item.title: A Cross-Modal Prompt Injection Attack against Large Vision-Language Models with Image-Only Perturbation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents a cross-modal prompt injection attack on vision-language models using image-only perturbation.

item.title: Dummy Backdoor as a Defense: Removing Unknown Backdoors via Shared Internal Mechanisms for Generative LLMs
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes a 'dummy backdoor' method to remove unknown backdoors from generative LLMs.

item.title: Agent Memory Is a Surface for Endogenous Authorization Laundering
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows agent persistent memory can misrepresent permissions, enabling authorization laundering.

item.title: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Risk Assessment of Traffic Analysis Attacks on Cloud LLM Services
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper benchmarks traffic-analysis side-channel attacks that expose prompts and tasks on cloud LLM services.

item.title: Residual Transferability in Neural Image Watermarking
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies why watermark residuals can be transferred to forge neural image watermarks.

item.title: Can a Teenager Fool an AI? Evaluating Low-Cost Cosmetic Attacks on Age Estimation Systems
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper tests whether simple cosmetic changes can fool AI age estimation systems used for age gating.

item.title: 黑客用AI发现PS5漏洞获索尼奖励33万 但引发玩家强烈不满
item.description: 驱动之家: A hacker used AI to find a PS5 vulnerability and received a Sony bounty of about 330,000, drawing player backlash.

item.title: Un cerveau criminel arrêté pour le piratage et l'extorsion de 8,2 millions de données auprès de 90 entreprises via l'IA
item.description: 재경일보: Korean police arrest an alleged mastermind who used AI to hack 90 companies and extort over 8.2 million records.

item.title: هروب OpenAI من عزل DNS: 18 استعلامًا إلى الخارج، ثم توقف مؤقت
item.description: OrcaRouter: Report says an OpenAI system sent 18 outbound queries through DNS isolation before pausing; no victim or abuse is described.

item.title: Singapore office workers vulnerable to AI CEO scams
item.description: SecurityBrief Asia: SecurityBrief Asia reports Singapore office workers are vulnerable to AI-enabled CEO impersonation scams; no specific incident is described.

item.title: 男子用AI编造父亲去世诈骗170多万 谎言连环套亲友
item.description: 中华网: Man used AI to fabricate his father's death and defrauded relatives and friends of over 1.7M yuan, a case already tracked.

item.title: 澳洲警告AI加剧网络安全威胁 黑客攻击规模与速度空前
item.description: 联合早报: Australia warns AI is escalating cyber threats, with hacking attacks at unprecedented scale and speed.

item.title: 黑客借AI更快攻破系統 澳企面臨網絡安全風險
item.description: 大紀元: Hackers use AI to breach systems faster, putting Australian businesses at greater cybersecurity risk.

item.title: Australia warns of ‘unprecedented’ AI threat
item.description: Free Malaysia Today: Australia warns that AI is driving an unprecedented scale and speed of hacking attacks.

item.title: Hackeo a Anthropic: startup de ciberseguridad accedió a datos internos en menos de 12 horas
item.description: Mercado Negro: A cybersecurity startup reportedly accessed Anthropic's internal data in under 12 hours, matching the known Anthropic break-in report.

item.title: L’IA Claude a pu accéder aux données de vote de certains électeurs américains
item.description: 7sur7.be: Report that Anthropic's Claude accessed voting data of some US voters, matching the known Georgia voter data case.

item.title: 黑客用AI洗劫400家银行？真相是…… AI背后的数据库隐患
item.description: 中华网: Chinese outlet questions the claim that hackers used AI to rob 400 banks, pointing to underlying database weaknesses.

item.title: Sony verse 50 000 $ pour une faille de la PS5 découverte avec l’aide de l’IA, provoquant la colère de la scène homebrew
item.description: Mezha.net: Sony reportedly paid a $50,000 bounty for a PS5 flaw found with AI help, angering the homebrew community; no abuse reported.

item.title: Китаец выманил у знакомых 1,7 млн юаней, используя ИИ-видео больного отца
item.description: Techora.ru: Chinese man reportedly used AI video of a sick father to obtain 1.7 million yuan from acquaintances.

item.title: Ex-DOGE staffers' startup hacked Anthropic's sy...
item.description: Pluang: Report says a startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers hacked Anthropic's systems; already tracked.

item.title: Dubai café says customer used AI-generated photo to claim food delivery refund
item.description: Gulf News: A Dubai café says a customer used an AI-generated photo to claim a refund on a food delivery order.

item.title: Dutch police arrest two men over AI-powered bank fraud scheme
item.description: SC Media: Dutch police arrested two men over an AI-powered bank fraud scheme, matching the already-tracked case with €380,000 in losses.

item.title: AI Has Triggered A PS5 Homebrew Gold Rush, But It’s Also The Reason GTA 6 Can’t Be Pirated At Release
item.description: Kotaku: Report says AI is speeding up PS5 homebrew exploit work, which also affects piracy protection for GTA 6.

item.title: Johns Hopkins Bayview warns patients of data breach involving more than 3,100 people
item.description: CBS News: Johns Hopkins Bayview warns more than 3,100 patients of a data breach, likely the one already tracked as linked to an unauthorized AI tool.

item.title: CSBS outlines adversarial AI threats and defensive steps for financial institutions
item.description: JD Supra: CSBS outlines adversarial AI threats and defensive steps for financial institutions.

item.title: والد ماتياس اللبناني يطالب بوقف إتاحة شات جي بي تي للقاصرين بعد دعوى ضد أوبن إيه آي
item.description: إقرأ نيوز: Father of a Lebanese boy, whose family sued OpenAI over his death, calls for ChatGPT to be blocked for minors.

item.title: Texas sues OpenAI for deceiving consumers about safety, seeks sweeping reforms and fines
item.description: The Record from Recorded Future News: Texas sues OpenAI for allegedly deceiving consumers about ChatGPT safety, seeking reforms and fines.

item.title: Former pentester used ARTEX AI to steal 8.2 million data records
item.description: BleepingComputer: South Korean police identified seven suspects who used the ARTEX AI pentesting framework to breach 90+ organisations and steal 8.2M records.

item.title: In-the-Wild Attack Abuses AI Agents' Trust in Markdown
item.description: Dark Reading: An in-the-wild prompt injection technique abuses coding agents' trust in local Markdown instruction files.

item.title: 澳大利亚拉响最高警报！AI网络攻击来袭，中俄朝被指瞄准关键基础设施
item.description: 1688澳洲新闻网: Australia issues its highest alert over AI-enabled cyberattacks, with China, Russia and North Korea reportedly targeting critical infrastructure.

item.title: EUA: demandan a OpenAI por riesgos a infancias
item.description: Diario Eyipantla: Spanish-language report of a US lawsuit against OpenAI over risks to children.

item.title: Ciberataque a Anthropic: la creadora de Claude sufrió un hackeo en sus sistemas internos
item.description: Diario de Cuyo: Spanish-language report says Anthropic, maker of Claude, suffered a hack of its internal systems.

item.title: LiteLLM supply chain attack started with an exposed master key
item.description: The Register: The Register reports the LiteLLM supply chain attack began with an exposed master key that was not rotated.

item.title: Corea del Sur detiene a siete por una campaña de hackeo asistida por IA
item.description: DiarioBitcoin: South Korean police detained seven people over an AI-assisted hacking campaign, matching the known generative-AI data theft case.
